response.text: Your goal is to migrate 6 existing Zaps to self-hosted n8n. To complete this, I will rebuild each one in n8n, test it with you, and hand over a short doc. First, I will audit and map the 6 existing Zapier workflows covering form to Google Sheets, Sheets to Slack alerts, Stripe payment to email receipt, and three Gmail filters. Next, I will rebuild the form to Google Sheets and Sheets to Slack alerts workflows in self-hosted n8n. Then, I will build new workflows to handle the Stripe payment to email receipt and the three Gmail filters in self-hosted n8n. I did nearly this: built an n8n workflow for lead intake using form webhooks, field validation, a duplicate check by email, a new Google Sheets row, and a Slack alert to the sales channel, which reduced manual entry from about 2 hours a week to under 10 minutes. Which specific error handling or logging requirements do you have for the migrated workflows?
